onThisDay.text: Guru Gobind Singh, the tenth Sikh Guru and founder of the Khalsa, died, leaving behind a profound legacy of spiritual and military leadership.
Mother Teresa established the Missionaries of Charity in Kolkata, creating a globally renowned institution dedicated to serving the poorest of the poor.
Begum Akhtar, the legendary Indian singer known as the 'Mallika-e-Ghazal', was born, shaping the classical music and ghazal traditions of India.
An asteroid designated 2008 TC3 exploded over Sudan in the first-ever successful prediction of an asteroid impact prior to atmospheric entry.
The Battle of Lepanto was fought, marking a major naval defeat for the Ottoman Empire and ending the era of large-scale galley warfare in the Mediterranean.
